assumptions: Input order is acquisition order; only consecutive records of the same non-null line are connected. No implicit sorting or connection across interleaved lines.
Distances are horizontal in native linear CRS units; speed is those units per second. Missing context prevents affected checks; explicit gaps and nonpositive time intervals break segments.
Spike candidates compare a complete odd sample window against its median, in channel units. They may be real geology; no values are removed or corrected.
Repeated-station statistics are descriptive, not instrument precision or geological uncertainty. Station IDs identify the same station only when the caller supplies that identity.
Clearance is a measured input in metadata.height_units. It is not inferred by subtracting elevations.
Unspecified correction history remains unknown; QC does not apply corrections.
workflow_support: Direct observation QC API; raster workflow v1 remains raster-only.
